hooks.hook_text: Modern Treasury now supports FedNow and RTP, enabling instant payments at scale.
hooks.rationale: For an operations leader, instant payment capabilities cut settlement times and reduce manual reconciliation effort, directly improving cash flow visibility.
hooks.bridge: Our automation platform can seamlessly reconcile these high‑velocity payments, eliminating the manual steps your team currently faces.

hooks.hook_text: Modern Treasury has launched an integrated PSP that processes both fiat and stablecoins.
hooks.rationale: Handling fiat and stablecoins in a single system reduces the operational complexity and manual cross‑system checks that ops teams must manage.
hooks.bridge: We automate the end‑to‑end reconciliation of multi‑currency transactions, ensuring your team can reconcile fiat and stablecoin flows without manual effort.
